prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a final Minecraft builder reference sheet refining the attached Sears Modern Homes concept (image-3 is the edit target; image-1 is the mood board). Landscape 3:2, plain warm light background, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel blocks, skilled human builder quality, no characters or animals. TWO MAIN VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE: LEFT straight-on orthographic NORTH front elevation of the entire eight-house row; RIGHT NORTH-EAST three-quarter view of the SAME entire row at the SAME SCALE. Both views include all eight houses in identical order, no omissions. Use generous empty space below for enlarged construction details, keeping the two long rows readable. Small labels 0 Magnolia, 1 Alhambra, 2 Vallonia, 3 Puritan, 4 Cornell, 5 Stanford, 6 Winona, 7 Craftsman. Preserve the prior coordinated white, cream, sage, pale yellow, grey and brown colors, gardens, paired/triple framed double-hung windows, deep porches and house identities.

Exact grid: each row is 128 blocks along x, eight 16-wide plots; plot i x=16*i..16*i+15, z=5..24 (20 deep). Road z=0..2 gravel, sidewalk z=3..4 smooth_stone. Each house faces north, has a lawn to the sidewalk and centered front walk; all eaves, masonry and shrubs inside its plot. No front fence. Same low oak_leaves hedge on rear and sides. Modest gardens. Ground floor at most one block above lawn.

Correct the three principal shortcomings of the prior concept: (1) Puritan must have a strongly legible DUTCH GAMBREL, steep lower slopes and shallow upper slopes with visible angle breaks, long wide shed dormer; Cornell roof must remain LOW hipped with small hipped dormer. (2) Alhambra must have a CURVED SHAPED MISSION PARAPET approximated with stepped vanilla blocks, raised central curved silhouette with low shoulders, NOT a triangular stepped gable; deeply recessed THREE ROUND ARCH porch openings approximated with stairs/slabs, NOT a timber pergola. (3) All entrances must use half-step slab approaches, NOT stair stoops, and chimneys need open constant-width wall-integrated shafts rather than capped decorative stacks.

House specifics: 0 Magnolia white Georgian Colonial Revival, grandest, two-and-half storeys, symmetrical FIVE bays, full-height white quartz_pillar portico columns, balcony over central door, side-gabled dark roof with three dormers. 1 Alhambra two-storey white_terracotta stucco, shaped Mission parapets and brick red tiled roof edges, triple arcaded porch. 2 Vallonia sage green_terracotta, one-and-half storeys, side-gabled roof sweeping over full-width porch, broad dormer, tapered posts on brick piers, spruce knee braces and exposed trapdoor rafter tails. 3 Puritan pale birch clapboard Dutch Colonial with true gambrel and long shed dormer, small columned pediment entry. 4 Cornell light_gray_terracotta two-storey cube, low hipped roof, hipped front dormer, full-width porch with square columns. 5 Stanford white Cape Cod, one-and-half storeys, steep side-gabled roof, TWO gabled dormers, central chimney, central door and dark shutters. 6 Winona cream smooth_sandstone, small ONE-storey front-gabled cottage with small porch under gable, visibly lowest and simplest. 7 Craftsman two-storey front-gabled, spruce shingle upper floor and sage lower clapboard, broad porch on stone piers, wide bracketed eaves.

Show actual block-sized depth, proud trim, recessed openings, stairs/slab roof verges and eaves, ridge, fences, walls, trapdoors and lanterns. Only exact Minecraft 1.21.1 materials: birch_planks, white_terracotta, green_terracotta, light_gray_terracotta, smooth_sandstone, smooth_sandstone_stairs, smooth_sandstone_slab, quartz_pillar, quartz_stairs, quartz_slab, spruce_planks, spruce_stairs, spruce_slab, spruce_fence, spruce_trapdoor, spruce_door, deepslate_tiles, deepslate_tile_stairs, deepslate_tile_slab, bricks, brick_stairs, brick_slab, brick_wall, stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall, dark_prismarine, dark_prismarine_stairs, dark_prismarine_slab, glass_pane, oak_leaves, grass_block, gravel, smooth_stone, smooth_stone_slab. Dark deepslate roofs predominate, red brick on Mission roof edges. No pale oak, invented blocks or smooth curves.

Below main views show three enlarged precise builder detail insets: A accessible entry with two-wide smooth_stone_slab bottom-slab approach rising half a block at a time, maximum two half-step rises to ground floor one block above lawn, then 2x2 LEVEL landing with final cell before spruce_door level, NO stair blocks on entry approach. B Alhambra arch and Puritan gambrel silhouette closeups clearly showing their corrected block geometry. C wall hearth sectional cutaway: campfire at BOTTOM on hay_block hidden below floor, fire just outside wall with mouth opening into parlour, 1x1 AIR flue surrounded on all four sides by constant-width bricks, roof stops against masonry, open uncapped mouth 1-2 courses above roof, entirely in plot. Small adjacent family interior cutaway: upstairs 3-4 whole white_bed/light_blue_bed with heads against SOLID walls, no window behind heads, two clear air blocks above beds, clear routes, spruce_stairs interior flight top flush with floor; downstairs parlour, dining table spruce_fence plus spruce_pressure_plate, spruce_stairs chairs, kitchen smoker stove, chest, barrel, crafting_table, lanterns for spawn-proof lighting. Main houses remain intact; cutaways are explanatory insets. Minimal neat typography, no large marketing title. Render architecture accurately as a buildable voxel reference, not photoreal architecture.

roles.role: Painted clapboard, stucco and shingle walls
White columns, window frames, pediments and arch approximations
Dark roofs, eaves, verges and ridges
Mission roof coping, porch piers and chimney masonry
Foundations, hearth surrounds and stone porch piers
Wood floors, brackets, rafters, rails, doors and shutters
Road, sidewalk, entry walks and slab landings
Family furnishings, kitchen and interior decoration

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool, inspected, and saved unmodified as concept-2.png in the current directory.

Biggest prior gap: the Puritan lacked a recognizable gambrel. Added a roof-profile detail and emphasized the shed dormer; the rendered angle break remains weak and needs correction during construction.
Biggest prior gap: the Alhambra lacked its arcaded Mission porch. Added three recessed stair-and-slab arches and a parapet detail; the parapet still reads more triangular than curved.

Biggest prior gap: raised stair stoops conflicted with the access standard. Added an enlarged slab-entry reference, but the image still depicts too many rises; build with only two half-block rises and a true 2-by-2 level landing.
Preserved all eight models in order, coordinated period colors, lawn frontage, framed window rhythms, deep porches and contrasting house sizes.
Placed the complete elevation and three-quarter row side by side, with plot dimensions and construction details below.
Added an open wall-chimney section and furnished interior examples. The exposed hay in the section is explanatory; hide it below the finished floor.

Inspection limits: the interior shows only two clearly visible beds, and the image cannot verify exact plot dimensions, bed clearance, stair connections, flue continuity or spawn-proof lighting. These remain build requirements.
